comment: Professor van der Laan Smith changed my life. For those of you who truly want to understand accounting and become the best investor/business analyst possible, take her class. The things I learned will help me in the future with job recruiting as I have such a strong foundational knowledge of accounting because of her.
she loves throwing you curveballs. beware of this during quizzes, tests and even projects

Was scared to take her based on her past reviews, but I'm glad I did. She gives a decent amount of extra credit, is nice and understanding, and her exams aren't too hard. Just gotta make sure to read the chapters. Sometimes her quizzes are completely different from the practice but it's aight. Killer sense of fashion too

Dr. Van der Laan Smith is a great professor, and probably the easiest of the accounting professors at UR. She is accessible outside of class, but the class is generally difficult (but I'm not very good at business classes anyways). If I could suggest one thing, it is to make sure you have a good, smart group. There are many group quizzes.

Professor Smith is an okay teacher. Her lectures are mostly right out of the textbook but gives helpful practice problems in class. BUT the tests (2 per semester) are really really hard!!! She does give extra credit, but it isn't quite enough to salvage bad test grades (even with corrections)...

Super fast-paced lectures; will spend about 20 min per chapter. ALL questions worth 6 points, only like 25 questions per test. Tests are HARD, but gives 1-point-back test corrections. Fairly helpful during office hours. No review sessions. Detail-oriented for financial projects. Need prior experience in an accounting class to do well.

Not a helpful teacher at all if you are struggling to understand the material but does her best to give students extra credit.  Many of the in-class quizzes are done with a group, making them easier.  Tests are usually harder than the problems you practice in class.

Professor Smith speaks super fast and moves through chapters without any decent explanation. Work piles up- e.g. a hard test, project, essay, and long assigned readings all within 2 weeks.  Worst professor I've had.  Doesn't care about students' progress or understanding. Will probably be getting a B- if the tutoring sessions continue to help!

the class is not that hard but she's a really bad teacher. She gets everything straight out of the book and has a hard time explaining things. i've found that i teach myself most concepts. Would not recommend for anyone looking to major.
Awesome teacher! Willing to consider student perspectives. Easy and fair grader, most of the quizzes are in groups. Gives chance to gain back half the points lost in tests through corrections.

She is great. Very helpful, gives you tons of opportunities to get an A. Lots of quizzes but she lets you take some as a group. I would definitely recommend her. She lets you do test corrections and has great powerpoints.

Dr. Smith is a great teacher. She knows how to make her students understand the material by doing lots of practice problems during class. Her tests are decently hard, she gives you a lot of chances to get an A. Thanks to her I like accounting a lot more now. I would fully recommend her.
She is a very fair teacher.  Teaches from the text book and from her notes.  Tests are straightforward.  Her class is not difficult so long as you put in some effort.
Dr Van Der Laan Smith is an amazing professor. Shes incredibly clear, teaches from her notes, and gives fair tests. Take her if you can!
